title: The krn lane run verb is removed after the pilot moved to the replay driver
body:
Split of S24 (t-x4z168s), step 3 of 3. After the driver lives under evals/replay and the pilot runs through it, the `krn lane run` verb and the rest of src/cli/lane-run/ are removed; docs/program/fable-plan-brief.md's `krn lane run` proof line and the ADR 0022 mention of lane-canary.ts (a file that does not exist) are corrected.
Outcome: `krn lane run` exits 64 as an unknown verb; src/cli/lane-run/ holds only what other modules import (environment.ts tokenHelper) or is gone; plan S24 proof passes.
Proof: `bin/krn lane run --task x; test $? -eq 64` and `node evals/replay/run.ts --arms C --units 1` prints `verdict:`.
